Proposed diagram changes
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Replace whole-document snapshot publication with checkpoint capture, flush, manifest-pinned loading and publication. Keep isolated-diagram saving separate; the repository-facade organization remains accurate.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Add workspace checkpoint/item references, saved-context repositories, shared context sources, FileChatStore, FileDiffSessionRunStore and FilePushIntegrationStore under their storage owners. Preserve catalog/proposal separation and mark SearchArtifact PROPOSED and unimplemented.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Checkpoint-backed canvas publication
  |       `-- Explain how save_diagram reaches durable catalog publication: checkpoint request and flush, WorkspaceRecordStore.capture, head/version guards, selected dependency loading, publishCheckpoint and browser acknowledgement. Attach to Explicit catalog publication; failed acknowledgement does not undo publication.
  |
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Update checkpoint/view encoding, item sharing, semantic checkpoint immutability and bounded parallel durable writes. Retain the accurate browser-owner -> adapter -> worker -> server -> restore organization.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Add persisted document version, repository/parent metadata and saveDocument's acknowledged single-document transaction. Show CanvasCheckpointEncoder and CanvasValueEncoder beneath WorkspacePersistence's record projection before linking their detail.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Checkpoint deltas and shared immutable values
  |   |   `-- Explain independently addressable composition/view items, shared text, checkpoint diffs, depth-31 replay limit and checkpointHead references. Attach to CanvasCheckpointEncoder and CanvasValueEncoder; storage encoding preserves the existing read model and does not render it.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Durable batch publication and restore
  |       `-- Detail WorkspaceRecordStore.apply/publish: immutable-item checks, semantic re-encoding checks, at most eight writers, all writers settled, blob-directory sync, then atomic manifest and receipt. Connect restore through recordHistory/recordDocument; distinguish full workspace loading from selected-checkpoint capture and identical-request retry.
  |
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Replace the obsolete DiagramService ownership entry with explicit immutable revision operations and runtime retention; update persistence references to encoded checkpoints/items. The page/session/storage ownership outline remains useful.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Add CanvasViews outside undo-restored state, working-copy checkpoint references, presentation/review/context fields and their revision dependencies. Explain current-only export boundaries and why named views retain the complete graph; these fit the existing history-record organization.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |       `-- Replace the removed sole-service-writer boundary with createDiagram/reviseDiagram/deriveDiagram, explicit runtime retention, generation orchestration and CanvasHistory bindings. Separate retention from durable persistence; preserve immutable identity and proven correspondence. Link from the overview's revision-operations component and reuse C07/D01 for detailed revision behavior.
  |
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Distinguish attachment-scoped uploaded contexts from AgentContextService.resolve through the saved library; replace the obsolete RevisionedDiagramService generation call. Preserve capture/generate/apply order and do not imply edit-run maps survive restart.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   `-- Add source-range descriptors, optional portable source files and external source resolution while keeping the domain object free of file/network ownership. Introduce explicit AgentContextLibrary and DiagramAgentContextStore adapter connections.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Saved and diagram context persistence
  |       `-- Attach from AgentContextLibrary and DiagramAgentContextStore. Contrast globally saved immutable contexts with diagram backing-record references; show shared source blobs or pinned Git files, validation before reference publication, portable selected evidence and import preparation before workspace publication.
  |
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Update Diagram publication from snapshot-based whole-canvas saving to checkpoint-backed publication, and Agent context from backend-lifetime upload storage to uploaded plus saved-context resolution. Existing responsibility groups still fit.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       `-- Place AgentChatService, DiffSessionWorkflowService and PushIntegrationService under Run application features, with their file-store dependencies. These explicit components anchor the separate durable-execution overview without duplicating its lifecycle detail.
  |
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [H] Isolated history and undo/redo
  |   |   `-- Include presentation alternatives, review, contexts and their retained revision dependencies in CanvasHistoryRecord. The isolated-history organization remains accurate; reuse the shared history explanation rather than duplicating the workspace codec.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [MODEL] ChangeSession ownership
  |       `-- Expose the additional persisted proposed-document fields through ChangeDocumentState and its history reference. Preserve separate proposal persistence and atomic catalog acceptance.
  |
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
  |   |   `-- Show canvasViews as history-header metadata outside undo-restored snapshots, including recording and generation metadata. Preserve working-copy, branching and archive behavior; add the rule that named views pin their checkpoint/dependency graph during export.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Generated CanvasView persistence
  |       `-- Attach to Saved CanvasViews and branching's generation component. Show startGeneration pinning the saved parent, candidate run/chat identities, updateGeneration validating and retaining proposed revisions, and a fresh saved endpoint published only for finished generation; rendering stays outside this lifecycle.
  |
  `-- [3] Background execution - durable state and recovery  new canvas
      |-- Durable execution overview
      |   `-- Distinguish live execution handles from persisted chat sessions, CanvasView generation metadata, workflow runs/artifacts and push records. This cross-restart lifecycle needs its own overview rather than broadening the workspace autosave flow.
      |-- AgentChatService and FileChatStore
      |   `-- Show serialized chat-session writes through temporary-file rename and the separate CanvasHistory generation owner. Do not equate chat writes with WorkspaceRecordStore's fsync protocol or claim automatic execution resumption.
      |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService and FileDiffSessionRunStore
      |   `-- Show request-derived run identity, create/replay checks, stored capture/prompts/requests/responses/transcript/metrics, saved stages and terminal state. A stored running run without an active execution is reported interrupted, not resumed.
      |-- PushIntegrationService and FilePushIntegrationStore
      |   `-- Show connection records, generation records, exclusive create-if-absent claims and subsequent updates; connect workflow invocation to DiffSessionWorkflowService. Separate atomic claim publication from execution completion.
      `-- Attachments
          `-- Connect from PersistentLayer's explicit file-store components and Mapping backend's service components; connect CanvasHistory generation metadata to Generated CanvasView persistence.
